{
    "group": "SpecVersionDetector.detectOptionalVersion(String)",
    "cases": [
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "schemaUri",
                    "value": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2019-09/schema#"
                }
            ],
            "expected": "Optional.of(VersionFlag.V201909)",
            "description": "A known Draft‑2019‑09 schema URI should be resolved to VersionFlag.V201909 wrapped in an Optional."
        },
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "schemaUri",
                    "value": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema#"
                }
            ],
            "expected": "Optional.of(VersionFlag.V202012)",
            "description": "A known Draft‑2020‑12 schema URI should be resolved to VersionFlag.V202012 wrapped in an Optional."
        },
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "schemaUri",
                    "value": "http://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema#"
                }
            ],
            "expected": "Optional.of(VersionFlag.V202012)",
            "description": "The detector accepts the same Draft‑2020‑12 URI over HTTP (not only HTTPS)."
        },
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "schemaUri",
                    "value": "http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema"
                }
            ],
            "expected": "Optional.empty()",
            "description": "A known draft URI missing the trailing ‘#’ fragment is not recognised and returns an empty Optional."
        },
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "schemaUri",
                    "value": "http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#extra"
                }
            ],
            "expected": "Optional.empty()",
            "description": "A known draft URI with additional characters after the ‘#’ fragment is considered unknown."
        },
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "schemaUri",
                    "value": "HTTP://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#"
                }
            ],
            "expected": "Optional.empty()",
            "description": "URI scheme is case‑sensitive; an upper‑case “HTTP” should not match any VersionFlag."
        },
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "schemaUri",
                    "value": "http://json-schema.org/draft-04/ schema#"
                }
            ],
            "expected": "Optional.empty()",
            "description": "Internal whitespace inside the URI breaks the pattern, resulting in an empty Optional."
        },
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "schemaUri",
                    "value": "\nhttp://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#\t"
                }
            ],
            "expected": "Optional.empty()",
            "description": "Leading newline and trailing tab characters are not trimmed; the method should return empty."
        },
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "schemaUri",
                    "value": "   "
                }
            ],
            "expected": "Optional.empty()",
            "description": "A string consisting solely of whitespace characters should be treated as unknown."
        },
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "schemaUri",
                    "value": "... (truncated for brevity)","description":"A very long unknown string should be handled without error and return Optional.empty()."}
        ]
    }
]  	
}
